content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher and meat-counter professional with experience since 2015 in carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and customer service. Confident advising customers on cuts and preparation, making fresh sausages, and maintaining cold-chain temperature and hygiene checks. Completed vocational butcher training and holds a renewed basic HACCP certificate.

KEY SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning, trimming and portioning · Fresh sausage production · Customer advice on cuts and preparation · FIFO stock rotation · Cold-chain temperature checks · HACCP and hygiene routines · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · Cash handling

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides each week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Make four kinds of fresh sausage to the shop’s recipes: ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez. Produce about 40 kg weekly in the busy season.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef / 30% lamb in response to customer feedback. The ćevapi won second place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair in 2023.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily; rotate cold-room stock every morning using FIFO.
- Serve around 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at weddings and family events, including a 2024 wedding order for four lambs and two pigs serving 180 guests.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial on beef ribs, recording temperatures and weight loss; the shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at closing.
- Created a closing and cleaning checklist for equipment and work areas following a market hygiene inspection remark; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027; not yet passed

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good; customer communication) · German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear section headings, relevant progression from Counter Assistant to Butcher, quantified production and customer-service results, and a professional presentation. The profile quickly establishes the candidate’s experience, butcher training, HACCP certification and core technical capabilities. The experience section is especially credible and impactful: carcass volumes, weekly sausage production, customer volume, apprentice training, the award-winning ćevapi, dry-ageing trial and wedding orders provide useful evidence rather than generic claims. The CV also handles the master butcher exam accurately by stating that it is planned and not yet passed. No unsupported skills or experiences were detected when cross-referenced with the Original Candidate Information.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV is highly ATS-compatible: it uses standard headings, conventional reverse-chronological structure, text-based formatting, and relevant keywords including carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning, fresh sausage production, FIFO, cold-chain temperature checks, HACCP, hygiene, customer advice, cash handling, mincer and bandsaw operation, and butcher training. The job title and required terminology are represented clearly. A small ATS/alignment opportunity remains: the ad explicitly mentions packaging fresh meat, while the CV does not state the candidate’s supported experience of wrapping customer orders in paper. This can be added without implying experience with supermarket self-service packaging, tray sealers or labelling scales.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV is an excellent match for the two must-have requirements and most daily duties. It demonstrates completed butcher training, substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, HACCP knowledge, cutting and portioning, customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, temperature checks, hygiene routines and cash handling. It also strongly reflects FreshCart’s priorities of knowledgeable customer service, reliability, hygiene and pride in good work. Forklift licence is a genuine gap: the candidate’s notes state that he has used a hand pallet jack but has never operated a forklift and does not hold a forklift licence. The CV appropriately does not claim one. The document also does not show supermarket-specific experience with self-service shelves, tray sealers or labelling scales; the candidate’s material confirms that this experience is not held, so this is not a CV defect that should be disguised. The candidate’s preparation for the Master Butcher exam is a positive development point and is accurately presented.
critique.improvement_instructions: MINOR ALIGNMENT ENHANCEMENT — In the Professional Experience section under “Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante,” add a truthful bullet such as: “Wrap fresh meat orders in paper for customer collection, while maintaining clean and hygienic counter presentation.” This makes the supported packaging experience visible for the ad’s “cut, portion & package fresh meat” duty without claiming experience with tray sealers, labelling scales or self-service supermarket packaging. No other substantive changes are required.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter
